result.reason: The clause provides up to 90 days of paid transition access, but it does not require Vendor/Licensor to export or return Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, as required even by the fallback. It also excludes transition assistance following Licensee’s uncured material breach, although the playbook applies upon expiry or termination generally. The data-retention carve-out is not a substitute for an affirmative data-export obligation. The drafting also creates tension between automatic termination of all licenses and continued access, retains the error “has complied” as “as complied,” and omits the refund mentioned in the margin comment. Extending the return deadline and adding record-retention language go beyond what is necessary to implement the stated fallback, although the clause generally preserves the original termination framework.
